title: Duality Theory for Filter Stability in Hidden Markov Models
summary: This article is concerned with the problem of nonlinear (stochastic) filter stability for a discrete time hidden Markov model (HMM) with finite state and observation spaces. For this purpose, a comprehensive duality theory is developed whereby the dual control system is a backward stochastic difference equation (BSDE). The duality is expressed in two inter-related forms. In its variational form, the minimum mean squared error of optimal filtering equals the value of a dual optimal control problem.
